items.narration_text:
Another trip to their room? Another reminder about the chores?
Mom Alarm Clock brings morning alarms and everyday reminders together.

Set your child’s alarm from your iPhone. They use the wake-up check on their phone, and you see its recorded result on yours.

Schedule reminders for everyday jobs, like taking out the trash or walking the dog. Check the reminder’s recorded status from your phone, too.

Get alarm and reminder status updates as both phones sync, so you can check in on both routines.

Download Mom Alarm Clock for iPhone.
See how it works.
